balls.text: a bouncer outside off, Ashwin can't get bat on it, they sneak a bye though
full and just outside off, Ashwin has backed away to make room and squeezed that past backward point for four, smart shot that
that's the end of the pyrotechnics from Aniruddha, he was falling away as he tried to club that quick bouncer from Harris, top-edged towards mid-on, easy for Gibbs
again gets the front leg out of the way and swings a length ball over wide long-on for six, this one just about clears the rope
low full toss outside off, Anirudha squeezes it past a diving backward point for a couple
turned from way outside off to short fine leg for a single
not as convincing this time but gets four runs anyway, a short ball which the batsman misses, Gilchrist is standing up to the stumps, he can't collect that and it races past him to the boundary
a humongous six from Anirudha, gets the front leg out of the way and pummels the ball way over long-on
driven down to long-off for a single
almost a replay, a full ball outside off, batsman shuffles across and tries to paddle it, again he's out of the crease, as the ball rolls to the keeper, he makes his ground though

Badrinath is a goner, tries to smash the ball over midwicket, gets an inside-edge towards the keeper, he doesn't realise where the ball is and takes a couple of paces down the track, tries desperately to get back but is caught short by Gilchrist, he slams his bat to the ground in frustration, think he'll have a meeting with the match referee for that
length ball outside off, batsman backs away and thumps it towards long-off
punched along the ground to long-on for a single, Chennai just can't seem to find the boundary
a tidy over continues, an appeal for stumping after the batsman yet another misses while attempting a big swipe, just about lands his back foot in the crease in time
defended back towards the bowler

101.6kmh, full and outside leg, Badrinath can't connect, gets a leg-bye towards backward point for a single, there was an overthrow taken after the throw deflected off the batsman, umpires don't allow the second though since it came off the non-striker

guess what delivery Harmeet bowled this time? slower legcutter again, it was still too quick for Anirudha, who was looking to clobber that to midwicket but delayed his shot so much that it lobbed towards short cover again
a mishit from the batsman, another slower legcutter, looking to swing to the leg side, edges towards short cover
lucky boundary for Anirudha, a full toss just outside off from Harris, batsman looks to crack that through the off side, gets an outside edge past the keeper for four
full and outside off, Badrinath flicks to long-on for a single
just another single, Chennai need more than that, driven along the ground towards mid-on for one more
another single, this time it was a full ball on middle and leg, driven down to long-on
wide outside off, length ball, driven through covers for a single by Anirudha
Harris starts with a yorker cramping up the batsman, hits Badrinath on the boot and rolls away

Symonds makes a great effort to try pull off a caught-and-bowled but can't get there, Badrinath mishits the ballwhich loops to the right of the bowler, Symonds throws himself towards the ball but its too far for him
mistimes the ball back towards the bowler
slugged from outside off to deep midwicket, it was a short of length ball, the ball bounces a few yards inside the rope, but it beats the fielder racing across
massive shout for lbw, Badrinath misses the ball as he looks to swipe it to the leg side, struck on the front pad, pitching just outside off but looked to be missing leg
shortish ball on middle and off, batsman makes room to play it towards backward point
tossed up on middle, defended watchfully by Anirudha

and another wicket, Morkel this time, he seemed to have absolutely bludgeoned that, it was powerful but not high enough to beat Andrew Symonds at the long-on boundary, he takes an overhead catch to put Chennai in more trouble
Morkel shows he's not all about muscling the ball, dinks it past the keeper for a couple down to third man
back away and plays an inside-out loft over extra cover, lands short of Harris charging in from the rope
Badrinath charges out to get to the pitch of the ball and slams it straight for a six, Chennai need more of that
speared in by Ojha, Morkel dabs it towards backward point, misfield gifts him a single
length ball on off, defended towards Symonds at extra cover
shortish and wide, Badrinath looks to carve it to point, misses and lets out a scream of frustration
poor delivery from Harmeet, a full toss on the pads, mid-on is up, Badrinath clubs the ball over that fielder to pick up four runs
shortish ball on off, Morkel gets off the mark by pushing the ball towards midwicket
the legcutter does the job for Harmeet again, short of length and pretty wide, Dhoni looks to cut but gets an edge, ends as a simple catch to gully, Deccan are ecstatic
familiar slow legcutter, 97kmh, Badrinath slogs it towards midwicket
Badrinath gets way across the stumps and looks to paddle it from over middle towards fine leg, gets a single after he misses, but a bye results off a ricochet off Gilchrist's pads
50 stand comes up, Dhoni pushes it a few yards to the bowler's right, Symonds throws himself full-length to stop it
played uppishly towards midwicket, wide of the fielder there
again on legstump, nudged to square leg, Dhoni takes the first run quickly, but an alert Mohnish Mishra cuts off the second
on the pads, Dhoni plays with soft hands towards square leg, puts the skates on to complete the second
back of length, in the channel outside off, blocked towards backward point
short of length, angling into off, eased towards mid-off for a single to round off the over
pushed off the front foot towards Symonds at cover
Badrinath is lucky to survive, a short ball on middle stump, Badrinath goes for the pull, the ball lobs over the bowler, and lands wide of mid-on
a bit of width, Dhoni slaps it towards deep point for a single
just moves away a bit with the angle after pitching back of a length, Dhoni is beaten as he looks to push it towards extra cover
short and wide, helped along towards deep point by Badrinath
stretches foward and defends this one towards short cover
Badrinath is also down the track, plays inside-out over cover, again one-bounce to the fielder
Dhoni takes a couple of paces down the track and slams it to long-on, one-bounce to the fielder
punched down to long-on for a single
played with soft hands towards square leg
another straight hit for four, full and outside leg, Dhoni skips away from the stumps and cracks it past the bowler for four
good shot from Badrinath, pushes the run-rate over 6, fullish and outside off, driven crisply past a diving Harris at mid-off for four

Harmeet keeps on sending in the slower legcutter, 100kmh, Badrinath misses as he looks to cut off the front foot, Gilchrist collects and takes off the bails, he's very confident that Badri's gone but replays show the batsman has dragged his back foot back in time
short from Harmeet, Dhoni stands tall and whirls it over cover for a single
slower legcutter again, pushed towards Symonds at short cover off the front foot
length ball and wide outside off, Badrinath abandons his usual classical technique for a paddle from well outside off, one-bounce to fine leg
short of length on offstump, wristy clip behind square leg
single is taken this time, no alarms this time after Dhoni clips the ball in front of square leg

total confusion between the batsmen after Dhoni jabs the ball towards Symonds at cover, Badrinath had to scramble back and put the dive in to beat the direct hit from Symonds, Dhoni tooks a couple of paces before yelling 'Nooo'
length ball on legstump, nudged towards square leg this time for the fourth single in a row
on the pads, another easy single, glanced towards fine leg
tossed up this time, a little bit of spin away, Badrinath sensibly pushes it for a single towards cover
full and on legstump, Dhoni charges out and forces it towards long-on
slower legcutter, 102kmh, one of Harmeet's favourite deliveries, it was full and on middle and leg, tapped towards midwicket
short and wide, Dhoni gets it low on the bat, still enough power to sail wide of Symonds at extra cover for four
Badri is in far more control this time, glides it down to third man for a single
shortish ball, nips back and bounces sharply, taking Badri by surprise, hits high on the bat as he defends towards gully
well outside off, Badrinath looks to crash that through covers, no contact
Harmeet's first ball is on a length ball outside off, Dhoni moves way across and looks to clip it to midwicket, off the pads to the leg side
goes forward and eases this one towards mid-on for a single to end the over
down the leg side, tries a vertical sweep, mishit on the bounce to the keeper
length ball, Dhoni gets well forward and pushes back towards the bowler
sliding onto legstump, whipped off the backfoot towards fine leg
slips in the quicker one, 90kmh, arm ball, short and outside off, inside-edged towards backward square leg
starts with a fullish ball just outside off, defended off the front foot
back of length on middle and leg, blocked back towards the bowler
slips in the bouncer, 124.6 kmh, a late call for a wide as that ball sailed over the batsman's head
length ball on middle, played with the full face of the bat towards mid-on, pushed gently enough to take a single
moves nimbly across the stumps and work the legstump delivery down to fine leg for a single
walks across the stumps, getting forward to counter the seam movement, extra bounce means he is struck on the thigh pad
a Dhoni special, short and quite wide, Dhoni slashes it past a diving Gibbs at backward point
nips back in after pitching short of a length and just outside off, worked towards the leg side, plenty of bounce in this track
what an over this is from Symonds, this time Dhoni gets a streaky inside-edge as the ball jags in a touch from outside off, beats the keeper

another massive wicket, Chennai in tatters as Raina falls, a length ball around off, Raina backs away to make room and play it inside-out, gets an outside edge to the keeper, Raina walks even as Gilchrist belts out the appeal
and again Badtrinath can't get bat on ball, loud appeal but again the ball would have gone over
back of length on middle and leg, hit high onto pads, would have sailed over the stumps, rolls towards gully
full and outside off, mistimes it towards cover
length ball outside off, Raina gets forward and pushes it down to long-off
full and on middle and leg, blocked towards mid-on by Badrinath
defended towards midwicket, can't beat the fielder
yet another drop, Suman drops an overhead catch at gully, another sitter, Raina gets the leading edge as he looks to flick the  ball, goes through his fingers
lovely delivery from Harris, not too much movement but good bounce, short of length and angling across Raina, who can't get bat on it
back of a length and outside off, jabbed wide of slip
it's over for Vijay, a length ball angling into legstump, Vijay choose to stay on the backfoot, he misses while attempting a flick, ball strikes the back pad and that looked out, replays confirm it
punched elegantly by Vijay between the covers, Gibbs has another long chase, he manages to win the race this time, pulls it in a few yards inside the rope
angling across the batsman, well outside off, Vijay swipes at that one but misses
follows up with another cracking shot, short of length, just a bit of width, Vijay stands tall and cracks it behind point for four, third man was very fine
first six of the day,overpitched and swinging into the batsman, Vijay times that pick-up shot beautifully over midwicket
keeps it back of a length, Vijay plays off the backfoot towards point
length ball just outside off, nicely driven down the ground to mid-off, doesn't beat the fielder

third-time unlucky for Hayden, he gets forward to drive, punches it at throat height to Andre Symonds at cover, he doesn't drop many, certainly not simple chances like this, a horror innings from Hayden comes to an end
short of length and in the channel outside off, Hayden shoulders arms
another edge from Hayden, a length ball outside off, flies off the edge past point, rolls over the rope before Gibbs can drag it back
defensively punched off the backfoot towards the off side
way outside the off stump, Harris will have to re-bowl that one

dropped again, this time it is Sumanth, Hayden closes the face too soon, gets an outside edge towards gully, straight at  the fielder who again makes a hash of things by trying to take a shoulder high catch with his fingers pointing up
defended towards short cover for a single
that's more of the Hayden bowlers have come to fear, a muscular swat down the ground, just over the umpire's head for four
blocked back towards the bowler
dropped, RP grasses a sitter, Hayden smashes it straight to extra cover, reaches  RP at throat height, doesn't have to move at all, in and out, Hayden survives
round the wicket to Hayden, offspinners too, length ball defended towards the off side
first runs of the game come when Vijay flicks the ball down to fine leg
lovely delivery from Symonds this time, seams away after bouncing back of a length just outside off, beats Vijay's outside edge
Symonds bowling seam-up, starts with a delivery down the leg-side
Chennai are through to the final, Ojha slugs that one to Bollinger at long-on, Deccan are all out for 104, It's Chennai v Mumbai on Sunday
Ojha looks to cut but misses
makes room to cut, misses, the ball goes through to the keeper
the doosra, RP can only hit it back to the bowler
straighter one from Murali, defended back to the bowler
tips the ball just over the head of the bowler, Ojha gets a single
defended towards the off side, Murali rushes across to field
Deccan collapsing here, Chennai set to make their second final, the quick delivery that turns in just a touch, pitching on off, hitting on middle, bye bye Harmeet
Bollinger gets his fourth wicket, a yorker makes a mess of the stumps, Sumanth has to go, great way to finish his spell
139.8kmh bouncer, batsman ducks under it
Chennai move closer to victory, Harris charges down the track and looks to blast the ball over long-off, can't clear Vijay there, who takes a nonchalant catch in the deep
full toss outside off, slashed towards deep point for a single
fullish and outside off, Sumanth backs away and swings but can't connect
full and outside off, laced towards mid-off
overpitched, makes room and punches it crisply through extra cover for four, Deccan aren't going down without a fight
charges down the track and can only block it towards the bowler
slashed away to backward point, only a single this time
and another swipe to midwicket for four, muscular hit that one, Vijay dives near the rope in vain
again Harris skips towards leg, slog it powerfully over midwicket, way over the rope
Harris backs away and slaps that one towards cover
big appeal for lbw but that was sliding down leg, Ashwin completes a superb spell, 4-0-14-1
swung to backward square leg by Harris
defended back to the bowler
on the pads, nudged behind square leg
that's probably the end of the road for Deccan, fired in by Ashwin, Symonds looks to clear midwicket but can only find Vijay there
length ball outside off, driven down to long-on
inside-out loft towards sweeper cover for a single
sweeps from well outside off to Hayden at square leg
all along the ground to mid-on for a single
Symonds gets the ball towards backward point this time
again down the leg side, beats the batsman and keeper this time, he's been bowling over the stumps
down the leg side, Symonds paddle-sweeps that one for four, Morkel and Ashwin slide at the boundary and clash into each other, the ball just evades both of them
Symonds knows there's a need to get a move on, he charges out of the track and hammers the ball straight down the track
turned towards midwicket for a single
blocked back towards the bowler
a powerful sweep, Raina dives to his left but can only get a hand to it, that would have been one of the catches of the tournament if he had pulled it off
off the pads towards leg slip
swept towards short midwicket, Raina moves to his left to cut it off
full and wide, guided past slip to the third man boundary, Ashwin dives near the rope but to no avail
fired down the leg side, Symonds wanted the single, but is sent back after the ball goes to short fine leg
a touch shorter, swept to deep midwicket this time
full ball, swept towards square leg
length ball outside off, defended towards cover
down the leg side, Dhoni whips off the bails, umpire says not out
brain fade from Mishra, skips down the track very early, Jakati pushes it short and wide, Mishra's slog doesn't get close to the ball, Dhoni has the easy job of taking off the bails
back of a length angling into off, pushed back towards the bowler
full ball and outside off, Symonds punches it towards cover where Raina dives to his right to cut off the ball
short and wide, Symonds cuts that powerfully to backward point, Bollinger runs across from third man but can't field it
driven down to long-on to bring up the half-century
back of a length and just outside off, defended towards the bowler again
defended back towards the bowler, dot-ball count increases
clipped from legstump towards backward square leg
Gibbs is gone, his struggle is over, he was looking to cut that one, bottom edges it onto the stumps, Jakati has struck
punched over extra cover by Gibbs
defended off the front foot towards the off side
too early into the shot, lobs toward a diving short cover fielder, lands wide of Raina though
full and down leg, whipped towards deep midwicket
short and a bit of width, Symonds cracks it to deep point
beaten as Symonds wafts at the ball outside off,  a bit of away movement for Morkel
fuller and on off, eased past the bowler for a single
short of a length and outside off, punched towards Raina at extra cover
inside-edged onto the pads, ball rolls to the off side, batsmen zip through for a single
Morkel starts with a bouncer that Symonds is happy to duck under
swept to leg slip, on the bounce, Badrinath fields
on middle and leg, absolutely no room on offer from Murali, defended to the off side
guided past Hayden at gully, get back for the second
pushed to the off side off the front foot
a top-edged sweep lands short of fine leg
defended watchfully off the backfoot
oof, a top-edge from Gibbs to a short and wide ball, lobbed up in the air but lands safely fine of third man and goes for four
on middle stump, deftly tucked towards midwicket by Symonds
length ball outside off, defended towards the off side
full, on middle and leg, driven along the ground to long-on
Chennai are delighted as Rohit holes out to long-on, a short of length ball, nothing too threatening, Rohit hits to long-on where Murali pouches it
fullish ball turned towards midwicket
down the leg side, didn't look like it hit the pads, Murali lucky that wasn't called a wide
length ball, just outside leg, off the pads towards backward square leg
defended towards midwicket by Rohit

cheeky shot from Gibbs, moving across the stumps and paddling it very fine, Albie makes terrific ground to just pull it in, Gibbs thought it was going for four so was coasting, and had to switch on the afterburners to complete the third
fuller this time, tapped towards point for a single
starts with a shortish ball, Gibbs swings it towards backward square leg
length ball on middle and leg, pushed towards midwicket by Rohit
and another wicket gone, Chennai are delighted, Suman makes room and looks to crunch the ball past cover but Raina takes a smart catch to reduce Deccan to 23 for 2
reverts to back of length, blocked off the backfoot
fuller than usual and on the pads, Suman gets off the mark with a lovely clip over midwicket for four
back of a length and on offstump, defended off the back foot towards gully
Gilchrist's poor tournament continues, a full ball on the pads, Gilchrist backs away and chips it towards midwicket where Anirudha takes a low catch
Gibbs' struggle continues, he gets a thick outside edge towards point
Gilchrist was looking to step out, Ashwin bowls it shorter, Gilchrist stays in the crease and taps it to the off side
short ball on legstump, Gibbs swings it down to backward square leg
defended back towards the bowler
clipped towards square leg
Gibbs misses that by a long way, Ashwin fires it into the legstump, Gibbs down the track trying to loft but is hit on the body
mistimes a pull this time, not quite there to hit but he goes through with the shot anyway, clears midwicket again and he gets a couple
a touch fortunate there, full outside off and he was trying to drive him through the off side, caught the inside half of the bat and went over midwicket and rolled over the ropes
troubling him with the length here, full this time and Gilchrist can't get his bat down in time, missed and it just escaped the off stump
short outside off, tries to pull him over square leg, misses, good bounce here for the bowler
bowling it on a good length on leg, pushed wide of mid-on for a single
a hint of frustration there, short of a length on middle, makes way and tries to heave him over midwicket, misses
defended back towards the bowler off the backfoot
Deccan breathe easy, Gilchrist steps out and hits it over the bowler for six, nice timing on that, not much power behind the shot
slapped to short cover for another dot ball
speared into legstump, Gilchrist digs it out back towards the bowler
on middle and leg, clipped towards square leg
gets down on one knee and sweeps along the ground to backward square leg
pushed towards mid-on this time, no run
outside off, Gibbs goes for the cut and can't beat that three-man ring
driven towards point off the front foot, two men ready to pounce there
slanting into the pads, deflects to backward square leg
Gilchrist looks to swing to midwicket again, but misses and is struck on his body
defended off the backfoot towards mid-on
gets off the mark by pushing the ball towards point, good start for Chennai this
watchfully defended back to the bowler
goes for the big swing, gets a faint inside-edge onto his body, muted appeal for lbw
'Wait' is the call after he tucks it towards midwicket
defended towards midwicket
fired in by Ashwin from round the stumps, awkwardly blocked by Gilchrist
